result.question: What happened to Uzziah while holding a censer?

readings.answer: Leprosy broke out on his forehead
readings.support: with a censer in his hand to offer incense | leprosy broke out on his forehead
with a censer in his hand to offer incense, was enraged

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly says that as he raged in the temple, leprosy broke out on his forehead, which occurred in the same scene where he had a censer in his hand.
The text directly states, “Uzziah, with a censer in his hand… was enraged,” so being enraged also happened while he held the censer.
